description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-11. -->
## Fixes

- **Music — Download method:** All three choices fit without scrolling in portrait and landscape. Settings show a short method name; **Info** opens the full explanations without changing the selection. Existing selections and download-setting dependencies are preserved.
- **Music — Library playlist Download:** Download in a playlist's three-dot menu now follows **Stream download** or **Device files** instead of opening the Premium offer. **YouTube Music / external app** keeps Music's own behavior. The target comes from that playlist's menu, never the current player.

## Compatibility and verification

- Compatibility is unchanged. Downloads still require Music 7.25 or newer; older targets retain the existing skip warning.
- Focused host checks passed: 18 menu-scanner tests; Music 9.40.51 / 9.15.51 / 8.30.54 patched with 53 / 53 / 52 patches and no failures; rooted 9.40.51 had no missing extension references.
- On Moto Edge Plus 2023, Music 9.40.51: chooser, Info, cancellation, persistence and dependencies passed in portrait and landscape. A fully cached Library playlist reached our Remove confirmation; cancelling kept its copies. The same entry retained Premium in delegated mode.
- A new uncached stream download, writing device files and external-app handoff were not exercised for these fixes. The existing download backend is unchanged. Older versions were not runtime-tested; literal Music 6.2.0 was not tested. No device changes or repeat runtime tests are part of this release process.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.34.0...v1.34.1
